description: This file contains functions for handling Matrix poll voting, including normalizing options, resolving selected answers, and submitting poll responses via client actions.

methods.name: normalizeOptionIndexes
methods.description: Normalizes an array of option indexes by truncating, filtering finite numbers greater than zero, and removing duplicates.

methods.name: normalizeOptionIds
methods.description: Trims and deduplicates an array of option ID strings.

methods.name: resolveSelectedAnswerIds
methods.description: Resolves selected answer IDs and labels based on provided option IDs or indexes, validating against poll content.

methods.name: voteMatrixPoll
methods.description: Main function to vote in a Matrix poll, fetching the poll event, validating it, resolving answers, and sending a response.
